name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana provides credit support to micro and small businesses through eligible lending institutions.
eligibility: Micro and small business entrepreneurs who meet the applicable lending and scheme requirements.
application_process: Apply through participating banks, NBFCs and other eligible lending institutions.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
description: PMEGP supports eligible entrepreneurs in setting up new micro enterprises through a credit-linked subsidy and bank finance.
eligibility: Applicants must satisfy the applicable PMEGP eligibility and project requirements.
application_process: Apply through the official PMEGP portal, implementing agencies and participating banks.

name: Stand-Up India
description: Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans for eligible women and SC/ST entrepreneurs for setting up new enterprises.
eligibility: Applicants must satisfy the applicable Stand-Up India eligibility and lending requirements.
application_process: Apply through participating banks and the official Stand-Up India platform.

name: Udyam Registration
description: Udyam Registration is the official online registration system for eligible MSMEs.
eligibility: Eligible micro, small and medium enterprises can register through the official Udyam Registration system.
application_process: Complete the registration online through the official Udyam Registration portal.
